general.aboutDescription: Team Staraptor CUET is the first VTOL drone design team in Bangladesh from Chittagong University of Engineering & Technology (CUET). Set to make our mark at the METU VTOL Competition, our team of 20 passionate students—specializing in mechanical, aerospace, and related fields—is dedicated to designing cutting-edge UAV and VTOL aircraft systems. We're combining lightweight materials, advanced aerodynamics, and smart control systems to deliver a drone that excels in stability, efficiency, and mission accuracy. Our vision is to showcase Bangladesh's engineering talent on a global stage, inspiring innovation and collaboration across borders. Join us as we take flight!

progress.title: Initial Design & Aerodynamic Testing
progress.description: Completed initial aerodynamic CFD simulations and prototype testing for our hybrid VTOL configuration. The team is currently validating payload distribution and motor thrust metrics.

avionics.title: Electronics
avionics.desc: BLDC motors, Pixhawk flight controller, GPS

components.name: 3D Printer
components.desc: Used to manufacture custom aircraft parts such as mounts, brackets, and structural components during prototyping and testing.

components.name: LW-PLA Filament
components.desc: Lightweight PLA filament used for printing aerodynamic components such as wings and fuselage parts where low weight is critical.

components.name: PETG Filament
components.desc: Durable 3D printing material used for parts requiring higher strength and heat resistance.

components.name: Carbon Fiber Rods
components.desc: Structural reinforcement elements used inside wings or frames to increase stiffness while keeping weight low.

components.name: Brushless Motor
components.desc: Electric motor responsible for generating thrust to propel the aircraft.

components.name: Propellers
components.desc: Rotating blades that convert motor torque into thrust to move the aircraft through the air.

components.name: ESC (Electronic Speed Controller)
components.desc: Controls the speed and power delivered from the battery to the brushless motor.

components.name: Servo Motor
components.desc: Actuator used to control aircraft control surfaces such as ailerons, elevators, and rudders.

components.name: LiPo Battery
components.desc: Primary onboard power source that supplies electrical energy to motors and electronics.

components.name: LiPo Charger
components.desc: Specialized charger designed to safely charge lithium polymer batteries.

components.name: Flight Controller
components.desc: The central autopilot system that stabilizes the aircraft and manages navigation, sensors, and control algorithms.

components.name: Companion Computer
components.desc: Auxiliary onboard computer used for advanced processing such as computer vision, AI tasks, or mission logic.

components.name: GPS Module
components.desc: Provides global positioning data for navigation, waypoint following, and autonomous flight operations.

components.name: Airspeed Sensor
components.desc: Measures the aircraft's airspeed to support accurate flight control and efficiency optimization.

components.name: Camera
components.desc: Captures visual data for monitoring, surveillance, or computer vision tasks.

components.name: Wide Angle Lens
components.desc: Expands the camera's field of view to capture a broader visual area during flight.

components.name: Telemetry Radio
components.desc: Enables wireless data communication between the aircraft and the ground control station.

components.name: RC Transmitter
components.desc: Handheld remote controller used by the pilot to send control commands to the aircraft.

components.name: RC Receiver
components.desc: Onboard device that receives signals from the RC transmitter and passes them to the flight controller.

vtol2026.title: METU VTOL-2026
vtol2026.subtitle: Current Objective
vtol2026.overviewText: The 9th VTOL Aircraft Design Competition challenges university teams to design, build, and autonomously operate a hybrid VTOL UAV for simulated logistics missions. The scenario simulates cargo delivery to offshore platforms, requiring aircraft capable of vertical takeoff, efficient fixed-wing flight, and precise autonomous operation.

requirements.title: Aircraft Requirement
requirements.description: Hybrid VTOL configuration with vertical takeoff and landing capability, transition mechanism, autonomous hover stabilization, and minimum 5kg payload bay.

requirements.title: Mission Logistics
requirements.description: Simulated multi-point offshore maritime delivery including waypoint navigation, crosswind tolerance, and autonomous return-to-base failsafe protocols.

projects.name: STARAPTOR VTOL - V1
projects.summary: Flagship hybrid tilt-rotor VTOL aircraft engineered for the 9th METU Competition. Combines fixed-wing aerodynamic cruise speed with vertical hover precision and autonomous maritime delivery.
